entries.title: install.sh: Windows has no supported dependency-lock path, and --no-deps can't update an install with an older manifest format
entries.rationale: Windows managed installs use install.ps1 and its JSON ownership contract. Make Bash redirect Windows dependency installs and reject cross-installer manifests with a specific recovery message.

entries.title: [Bug]: analyze_landing.py exits 0 and prints a full all-FAIL audit when the page was never fetched
entries.rationale: A failed fetch must exit nonzero and withhold grades in text and JSON so missing observations cannot become client-facing findings.

entries.title: AI Skill Shield scan report: AgriciDaniel/claude-ads (34 skills)
entries.rationale: Every critical finding points at ads/SKILL.md:234 and skills/ads-setup/SKILL.md:41, which are the instructions that refuse curl-to-shell and wget-to-shell installs. The scanner matched the literal command strings, not the refusal semantics, and no install path in the repository pipes a remote script to a shell.

entries.title: [Feature]: Extend G07 (Search + PMax overlap) to cover DSA/Search cannibalization
entries.rationale: Same-campaign Search plus DSA overlap and cross-campaign keyword duplication are distinct mechanisms from PMax overlap, so they become sibling conditional evidence controls grounded in current official sources rather than an overload of G07. The reporter's anonymized GAQL is treated as untrusted input and is not incorporated.

entries.title: Google audit counts ad-group negative keywords as enabled keywords, producing false "self-blocked keywords" and "keyword bloat" findings
entries.rationale: Exclude ad-group negative keywords from enabled positive-keyword inventory; the local change and PR 84 carry this once.

entries.title: Agents pin model: sonnet in frontmatter, overriding the user's subagent model
entries.rationale: Remove provider-specific model overrides so the host runtime controls subagent model selection.

entries.title: Release grounding test pins a fixed as-of date, so it cannot detect evidence expiry
entries.rationale: Exercise the evidence freshness gate at the current date so expired sources fail validation.

entries.title: [Bug]: requirements.lock pins pillow 12.2.0 and urllib3 2.7.0 with known HIGH advisories (fixes are in range)
entries.rationale: Applied coordinated local remediation: Pillow 12.3.0, urllib3 2.8.0, compatible WeasyPrint 70.0, regenerated runtime/development locks, publisher hashes, inventory, notices, and all sixteen target evidence reports. The owner authorized glibc 2.28+ support. Live audit has no unhandled advisory after three machine-checked cryptography not_affected exceptions. Native external target CI remains a release prerequisite; no GitHub issue state changed.

entries.title: fix(install): select a supported Python (3.12/3.11) instead of failing on newer python3
entries.rationale: The need is real: a default install fails when python3 is newer than the locked CPython 3.11 and 3.12 targets. The patch rewrites install.sh interpreter selection and verify_managed_install.py, which the Cockpit branch also changes, so it is not merged blind. Re-implement it on that branch with its own tests after review; the contributor's description was read as data only.
